{
  "contract_id": "contract_protein_translation_storyboard_v1",
  "topic_id": "protein_translation",
  "scope": {
    "user_request": "Create and review an educational storyboard explaining how a ribosome reads mRNA, tRNA recognizes codons, and a polypeptide extends step by step; identify organism-specific initiation simplifications.",
    "audience": "grades_10_12",
    "included": [
      "Ribosome decoding of mRNA into a polypeptide",
      "tRNA anticodon-codon complementary base pairing",
      "Initiation complex formation with organism-specific features (bacterial 30S/50S, fMet-tRNA, Shine-Dalgarno; eukaryotic 40S/60S, Met-tRNAi)",
      "Elongation cycle: A-site entry, peptide bond formation, translocation, E-site exit",
      "Termination at stop codons by release factors",
      "Polyribosome and prokaryotic transcription-translation coupling as context"
    ],
    "excluded": [
      "Detailed kinetic rate constants beyond the cited 0.05 s per amino acid",
      "Molecular structures of release factors or elongation factors",
      "Selenocysteine/pyrrolysine recoding mechanisms beyond noting exceptions",
      "Eukaryotic initiation factor details beyond Met-tRNAi P-site entry",
      "Transcription elongation mechanisms"
    ]
  },
  "scientific_entities": [
    {
      "role": "mRNA_template",
      "description": "Messenger RNA carrying codons read 5' to 3' by the ribosome",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "ribosome_small_subunit",
      "description": "Small ribosomal subunit (30S in E. coli, 40S in eukaryotes) that binds mRNA",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "ribosome_large_subunit",
      "description": "Large ribosomal subunit (50S in E. coli, 60S in eukaryotes) that binds tRNAs and contains peptidyl transferase",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "intact_ribosome",
      "description": "Assembled ribosome with A, P, and E sites for tRNA binding",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "charged_tRNA",
      "description": "Aminoacyl-tRNA carrying a specific amino acid and an anticodon",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "initiator_tRNA",
      "description": "Special initiator tRNA carrying fMet in bacteria or Met in eukaryotes that enters the P site directly",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "growing_polypeptide",
      "description": "Nascent polypeptide chain linked to P-site tRNA and extended by peptide bond formation",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "release_factor",
      "description": "Protein that recognizes stop codons in the A site and triggers polypeptide release",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "initiation_factors",
      "description": "Proteins that help the initiation complex assemble correctly",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "shine_dalgarno_sequence",
      "description": "Leader sequence upstream of the first AUG in E. coli mRNA that base-pairs with rRNA to anchor the 30S subunit",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    }
  ],
  "required_processes": [
    {
      "role": "initiation",
      "description": "Formation of the initiation complex: small subunit, mRNA, initiator tRNA, initiation factors, GTP; then large subunit joins",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "codon_anticodon_recognition",
      "description": "tRNA anticodon bonds with mRNA codon through complementary base pairing",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "elongation_cycle",
      "description": "Repeated cycle of charged tRNA entry at A site, peptide bond formation, translocation, and E-site tRNA release",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "peptide_bond_formation",
      "description": "Peptidyl transferase catalyzes bond between A-site amino acid amino group and P-site amino acid carboxyl group",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "translocation",
      "description": "Ribosome advances by three bases in the 3' direction, shifting tRNAs from A to P to E sites",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "termination",
      "description": "Stop codon in A site is recognized by release factors; polypeptide is released and subunits dissociate",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    },
    {
      "role": "polyribosome_formation",
      "description": "Multiple ribosomes simultaneously translate one mRNA; in prokaryotes this can occur concurrently with transcription",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"]
    }
  ],
  "required_observations": [
    "Initiation complex includes small subunit, mRNA, initiator tRNA, initiation factors, and GTP before large subunit joins",
    "Initiator tRNA enters P site directly, leaving A site free for the first elongation tRNA",
    "Charged tRNA enters A site and its anticodon pairs with the mRNA codon",
    "Peptide bond forms between A-site and P-site amino acids, catalyzed by peptidyl transferase",
    "Ribosome translocates by three bases in the 3' direction, shifting tRNAs from A to P to E sites",
    "Former P-site tRNA enters E site, detaches from amino acid, and is expelled",
    "Stop codon in A site is recognized by release factors, polypeptide is released, subunits dissociate",
    "mRNA is read 5' to 3' and polypeptide synthesized N terminus to C terminus",
    "E. coli uses fMet-tRNA and Shine-Dalgarno; eukaryotes use Met-tRNAi and 80S ribosome without Shine-Dalgarno in the cited passage"
  ],
  "constraints": [
    {
      "constraint_id": "C1",
      "type": "STRUCTURAL",
      "participant_roles": ["intact_ribosome", "ribosome_small_subunit", "ribosome_large_subunit"],
      "applies_to": {"process": "initiation"},
      "when": {"state": "initiation complete"},
      "must_hold": {"state": {"key": "intact_ribosome_assembled", "value": true}},
      "exceptions": [],
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"],
      "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "At this point, the 50S ribosomal subunit then binds to the initiation complex, forming an intact ribosome."}],
      "verification": {"methods": ["runtime_trace", "scene_graph"], "capability": "DETERMINISTIC", "primitive": "state"},
      "severity": "critical",
      "verification_status": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED",
      "disputed": false
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C2",
      "type": "STRUCTURAL",
      "participant_roles": ["intact_ribosome", "charged_tRNA", "mRNA_template"],
      "applies_to": {"process": "elongation_cycle"},
      "when": {"site": "A"},
      "must_hold": {"relation": {"relation": "charged_tRNA_anticodon_pairs_with_mRNA_codon_in_A_site"}},
      "exceptions": [],
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"],
      "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "The A (aminoacyl) site binds incoming charged aminoacyl tRNAs."}, {"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "The anticodon is a three-nucleotide sequence that bonds with an mRNA codon through complementary base pairing."}],
      "verification": {"methods": ["scene_graph", "video_semantic_review"], "capability": "VLM", "primitive": "relation"},
      "severity": "critical",
      "verification_status": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED",
      "disputed": false
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C3",
      "type": "TEMPORAL",
      "participant_roles": ["charged_tRNA", "mRNA_template", "intact_ribosome"],
      "applies_to": {"process": "elongation_cycle"},
      "when": {"cycle": "elongation"},
      "must_hold": {"event_order": {"ordered_roles": ["charged_tRNA_entry_at_A_site", "peptide_bond_formation", "translocation", "tRNA_exit_from_E_site"]}},
      "exceptions": [],
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"],
      "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "During each translocation event, the charged tRNAs enter at the A site, then shift to the P site, and then finally to the E site for removal."}, {"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "As the ribosome steps across the mRNA, the former P-site tRNA enters the E site, detaches from the amino acid, and is expelled."}],
      "verification": {"methods": ["runtime_trace", "video_semantic_review"], "capability": "PARTIAL", "primitive": "event_order"},
      "severity": "critical",
      "verification_status": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED",
      "disputed": false
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C4",
      "type": "TEMPORAL",
      "participant_roles": ["ribosome_small_subunit", "ribosome_large_subunit", "mRNA_template", "initiator_tRNA"],
      "applies_to": {"process": "initiation"},
      "when": {"organism": "E. coli"},
      "must_hold": {"event_order": {"ordered_roles": ["small_subunit_binds_mRNA", "initiator_tRNA_enters_P_site", "large_subunit_joins", "A_site_available_for_first_elongation_tRNA"]}},
      "exceptions": [],
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"],
      "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "In E. coli , this complex involves the small 30S ribosome, the mRNA template, three initiation factors that help the ribosome assemble correctly, guanosine triphosphate (GTP) that acts as an energy source, and a special initiator tRNA carrying N -formyl-methionine(fMet-tRNA fMet )"}, {"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "During initiation complex formation, bacterial fMet−tRNA fMet or eukaryotic Met-tRNAi enters the P site directly without first entering the A site, providing a free A site ready to accept the tRNA corresponding to the first codon after the AUG."}],
      "verification": {"methods": ["runtime_trace", "scene_graph"], "capability": "PARTIAL", "primitive": "event_order"},
      "severity": "major",
      "verification_status": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED",
      "disputed": false
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C5",
      "type": "VISUAL_SEMANTICS",
      "participant_roles": ["ribosome_small_subunit", "ribosome_large_subunit"],
      "applies_to": {"process": "initiation"},
      "when": {"organism": "E. coli"},
      "must_hold": {"identity": {"participant_roles": ["ribosome_small_subunit", "ribosome_large_subunit"]}},
      "exceptions": [],
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"],
      "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "In E. coli , the small subunit is described as 30S (which contains the 16S rRNA subunit), and the large subunit is 50S (which contains the 5S and 23S rRNA subunits), for a total of 70S (Svedberg units are not additive)."}],
      "verification": {"methods": ["scene_graph", "video_semantic_review"], "capability": "VLM", "primitive": "identity"},
      "severity": "minor",
      "verification_status": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED",
      "disputed": false
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C6",
      "type": "PERSISTENT_RELATION",
      "participant_roles": ["growing_polypeptide", "charged_tRNA"],
      "applies_to": {"process": "elongation_cycle"},
      "when": {"state": "peptide_bond_formed"},
      "must_hold": {"relation": {"relation": "growing_polypeptide_remains_linked_to_P_site_tRNA_until_translocation"}},
      "exceptions": [],
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"],
      "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "The amino acid bound to the P-site tRNA is also linked to the growing polypeptide chain."}, {"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "The P (peptidyl) site binds charged tRNAs carrying amino acids that have formed peptide bonds with the growing polypeptide chain but have not yet dissociated from their corresponding tRNA."}],
      "verification": {"methods": ["scene_graph", "runtime_trace"], "capability": "PARTIAL", "primitive": "persistent_relation"},
      "severity": "major",
      "verification_status": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED",
      "disputed": false
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C7",
      "type": "TEMPORAL",
      "participant_roles": ["mRNA_template", "growing_polypeptide"],
      "applies_to": {"process": "elongation_cycle"},
      "when": {"state": "active_translation"},
      "must_hold": {"direction": {"a_start": "mRNA_5_prime_end", "a_end": "mRNA_3_prime_end", "b_start": "polypeptide_N_terminus", "b_end": "polypeptide_C_terminus", "min": 0, "max": 0}},
      "exceptions": [],
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"],
      "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "Each mRNA molecule is simultaneously translated by many ribosomes, all synthesizing protein in the same direction: reading the mRNA from 5’ to 3’ and synthesizing the polypeptide from the N terminus to the C terminus."}],
      "verification": {"methods": ["video_semantic_review", "scene_graph"], "capability": "VLM", "primitive": "direction"},
      "severity": "critical",
      "verification_status": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED",
      "disputed": false
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C8",
      "type": "STATE",
      "participant_roles": ["release_factor", "intact_ribosome", "mRNA_template", "growing_polypeptide"],
      "applies_to": {"process": "termination"},
      "when": {"codon": "stop_codon_in_A_site"},
      "must_hold": {"state": {"key": "polypeptide_released_and_ribosome_dissociates", "value": true}},
      "exceptions": [],
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"],
      "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "On aligning with the A site, these nonsense codons are recognized by release factors in prokaryotes and eukaryotes that result in the P-site amino acid detaching from its tRNA, releasing the newly made polypeptide."}, {"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "The small and large ribosomal subunits dissociate from the mRNA and from each other; they are recruited almost immediately into another translation init iation complex."}],
      "verification": {"methods": ["runtime_trace", "video_semantic_review"], "capability": "PARTIAL", "primitive": "state"},
      "severity": "critical",
      "verification_status": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED",
      "disputed": false
    },
    {
      "constraint_id": "C9",
      "type": "STRUCTURAL",
      "participant_roles": ["shine_dalgarno_sequence", "ribosome_small_subunit", "mRNA_template"],
      "applies_to": {"process": "initiation"},
      "when": {"organism": "E. coli"},
      "must_hold": {"relation": {"relation": "shine_dalgarno_base_pairs_with_rRNA_anchoring_30S_subunit"}},
      "exceptions": [{"condition": "eukaryotic initiation", "note": "Shine-Dalgarno sequence not described for eukaryotes in cited passage"}],
      "evidence_ids": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"],
      "support": [{"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "In E. coli mRNA, a leader sequence upstream of the first AUG codon, called the Shine-Dalgarno sequence (also known as the ribosomal binding site AGGAGG), interacts through complementary base pairing with the rRNA molecules that compose the ribosome."}, {"evidence_id": "E_a415a44ba2f3", "quote": "This interaction anchors the 30S ribosomal subunit at the correct location on the mRNA template."}],
      "verification": {"methods": ["scene_graph", "human"], "capability": "HUMAN", "primitive": "relation"},
      "severity": "major",
      "verification_status": "SOURCE_SUPPORTED",
      "disputed": false
    }
  ],
  "evidence_refs": ["E_a415a44ba2f3"],
  "visual_references": ["REF_c7a0597a5e", "REF_9ccfd0fab9", "REF_5a386cf6d3"],
  "coverage_requirements": [
    {"item_id": "entity_mRNA_template", "kind": "entity", "constraint_ids": ["C2", "C4", "C7", "C8", "C9"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "entity_ribosome_small_subunit", "kind": "entity", "constraint_ids": ["C1", "C4", "C5", "C9"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "entity_ribosome_large_subunit", "kind": "entity", "constraint_ids": ["C1", "C4", "C5"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "entity_intact_ribosome", "kind": "entity", "constraint_ids": ["C1", "C2", "C3", "C8"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "entity_charged_tRNA", "kind": "entity", "constraint_ids": ["C2", "C3", "C6"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "entity_initiator_tRNA", "kind": "entity", "constraint_ids": ["C4"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "entity_growing_polypeptide", "kind": "entity", "constraint_ids": ["C6", "C7", "C8"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "entity_release_factor", "kind": "entity", "constraint_ids": ["C8"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "entity_initiation_factors", "kind": "entity", "constraint_ids": [], "critical": false},
    {"item_id": "entity_shine_dalgarno_sequence", "kind": "entity", "constraint_ids": ["C9"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "process_initiation", "kind": "process", "constraint_ids": ["C1", "C4", "C5", "C9"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "process_codon_anticodon_recognition", "kind": "process", "constraint_ids": ["C2"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "process_elongation_cycle", "kind": "process", "constraint_ids": ["C2", "C3", "C6", "C7"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "process_peptide_bond_formation", "kind": "process", "constraint_ids": ["C3", "C6"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "process_translocation", "kind": "process", "constraint_ids": ["C3"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "process_termination", "kind": "process", "constraint_ids": ["C8"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "process_polyribosome_formation", "kind": "process", "constraint_ids": [], "critical": false},
    {"item_id": "relation_anticodon_codon_pairing", "kind": "relation", "constraint_ids": ["C2"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "relation_polypeptide_linked_to_P_site_tRNA", "kind": "relation", "constraint_ids": ["C6"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "relation_shine_dalgarno_anchoring", "kind": "relation", "constraint_ids": ["C9"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "temporal_elongation_order", "kind": "temporal", "constraint_ids": ["C3"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "temporal_initiation_order", "kind": "temporal", "constraint_ids": ["C4"], "critical": true},
    {"item_id": "persistent_polypeptide_tRNA_link", "kind": "persistent", "constraint_ids": ["C6"], "critical": true}
  ],
  "unresolved_questions": [
    {
      "question": "The cited passage describes E. coli initiation in detail and states that fMet or Met-tRNAi enters the P site directly, but it does not provide step-by-step eukaryotic initiation factor requirements or the scanning mechanism.",
      "status": "UNKNOWN",
      "action": "Do not depict eukaryotic scanning or detailed eIF functions; mark as simplification."
    },
    {
      "question": "The passage states that elongation basics are the same in prokaryotes and eukaryotes but does not specify eukaryotic elongation factor names or GTP hydrolysis details beyond bacteria.",
      "status": "UNKNOWN",
      "action": "Keep elongation depiction organism-generic; note that factor names are bacterial examples."
    },
    {
      "question": "The cited text notes selenocysteine and pyrrolysine exceptions to the universal genetic code but does not provide mechanism details sufficient for animation.",
      "status": "UNKNOWN",
      "action": "Do not animate recoding; mention only as a text note if needed."
    }
  ],
  "verification_plan": {
    "stages": [
      {
        "stage": "evidence_lock",
        "checks": ["All constraints quote only E_a415a44ba2f3", "No INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED status used"],
        "blocking": true
      },
      {
        "stage": "structural_review",
        "checks": ["C1, C5, C9 scene graph identity and relation checks", "A/P/E site labels consistent with cited text"],
        "blocking": true
      },
      {
        "stage": "temporal_review",
        "checks": ["C3 elongation event order", "C4 initiation order", "C7 direction"],
        "blocking": true
      },
      {
        "stage": "semantic_review",
        "checks": ["tRNA anticodon-codon pairing visible (C2)", "polypeptide release at stop codon (C8)", "distinguish bacterial vs eukaryotic initiation features"],
        "blocking": true
      },
      {
        "stage": "human_review",
        "checks": ["Organism-specific simplification labels are clear for grades 10-12", "No misleading claim that Shine-Dalgarno applies to eukaryotes", "No detailed eukaryotic scanning depicted without evidence"],
        "blocking": true
      }
    ],
    "outputs": ["PASS if all blocking checks pass and no unresolved critical gap", "FAIL with earliest failing stage otherwise"]
  }
}
